    public static void Serialize(LoginPacket obj, System.IO.Stream stream)
    {
        if (obj is null) return;
        StreamWriter.WriteByte(stream, (byte)(obj.Result));
        StreamWriter.WriteUInt32(stream, (uint)(obj.UserID));
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj.Username))
        {
            stream.WriteInt32(0);
        }
        else
        {
            var usernameStringByteCount = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(obj.Username);
            var usernameStringTotalBytes = usernameStringByteCount + sizeof(int);
            if (usernameStringTotalBytes <= 256)
            {
                Span<byte> usernameStringBuffer = stackalloc byte[usernameStringTotalBytes];
                System.Buffers.Binary.BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(usernameStringBuffer, usernameStringByteCount);
                var usernameStringActualBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(obj.Username, usernameStringBuffer.Slice(sizeof(int)));
                stream.Write(usernameStringBuffer.Slice(0, sizeof(int) + usernameStringActualBytes));
            }
            else
            {
                var usernameStringBufferRented = System.Buffers.ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(usernameStringTotalBytes);
                try
                {
                    var usernameStringBuffer = usernameStringBufferRented.AsSpan(0, usernameStringTotalBytes);
                    System.Buffers.Binary.BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(usernameStringBuffer, usernameStringByteCount);
                    var usernameStringActualBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(obj.Username, usernameStringBuffer.Slice(sizeof(int)));
                    stream.Write(usernameStringBuffer.Slice(0, sizeof(int) + usernameStringActualBytes));
                }
                finally
                {
                    System.Buffers.ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(usernameStringBufferRented);
                }
            }
        }
    }
